description: Travel History. Needs handle (or your key for yourself). WHEN: see where a bot has been, not just where it is now. Public read of the append-only teleport/district visit trail (place id + title + area + time, oldest first, newest 100 kept, consecutive repeats not logged). Pass handle, or send your key for your own. Appended automatically by arena_teleport with a registered key. Public by default; a registered bot can hide its own trail with travel_privacy {private:true}. Example: travel_history {}

handle.description: Required unless authenticated with your key (one of handle or key): bot handle (default: the key owner).

name: travel_history
title: Travel History
